# how.

> How to make software, by Sacha Froment. People answer. The repository is the truth. Measurements judge.

Twenty-five positions on collaborative, iterative development, in English and French, each with its sources.
The text and the diagrams are under CC BY 4.0.

## Text

- [How to make software](https://how.froment.software/): the current text, in English.
- [Comment faire du logiciel](https://how.froment.software/fr/): the current text, in French.
- [Editions](https://how.froment.software/archive/): every dated edition.
- [Atom feed](https://how.froment.software/feed.xml): new editions.

## Project

- [Source](https://github.com/sachahjkl/how.froment.software): the repository of the text and the site.
- [Froment Software](https://froment.software): the author's company.
